correctness.rationale: Rule 12 outputs exactly the cyclic 01 transitions in the input. Nonzero feasible outputs have gaps d_i>=2; between consecutive output markers a predecessor has exactly one 10 transition and d_i−1 choices, independent between gaps. Repeated primitive gap pattern with repetition h has A choices per block; quotienting by the stabilizer cyclic group order h gives δ=(1/h)Σ_j A^gcd(h,j). For nonuniform gap multisets consecutive grouping yields primitive gap words, so the unquotiented product is attained. Integer-break local replacements force sizes 4 or 5; normalized ratios ρ_d=(d−1)/4^(d/5) bound any defect. A uniform all-5 output pays a strict necklace symmetry penalty, hence n multiple 5 improves by five 4-gaps for large n. Finite n<=20 checked in package, and independent brute-force ring enumeration n=5,8 returned maximal degrees 4 and 8. General proof not inferred from finite enumeration.
